title: 7 Insane Use Cases For Manus AI (with Zero Code)
description:

Meta just acquired an AI company that doesn't give you answers, it does the actual work for you. Manus AI went from zero to $100 million in just 8 months, and after obsessively testing it with my team, I can tell you it lives up to the hype.

In this video, I walk you through 7 real use cases where Manus replaces hours of manual work with a single prompt. From building websites and apps to hiring, lead gen, and recovering lost revenue, every example includes a step by step breakdown you can follow along with.

Watch to the end because the last use case could put tens of thousands of dollars back in your pocket.

Prompt from the video (Chief of Staff Calendar Analysis):

Pull my Google Calendar for the current week and next 4 weeks. Cross-reference every event against my Master Prompt (attached) to evaluate goal alignment, [task/department/company] time split , leverage level, and deep vs. shallow work. Then audit every event for quality issues: missing location, missing agenda, missing attendees, no confirmed RSVPs, vague titles, duration anomalies, scheduling conflicts, and missing prep docs. Merge both analyses into one Slack-formatted post organized by weekly buckets with completeness scores and a top-5 priority action list for my Chief of Staff. Post it directly in [desired slack channel] tagging me and my COS. Schedule to run every Saturday at 5 PM PST.
